title: Rounding Ramp · Q1 W02 D02
objective: Round numbers to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Look at the digit to the right of the place you are rounding. Five or more rounds up; four or less stays down. Ready to explore?
